title: A compatible binary tower pair admits a representing counit
statement:
Fix a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. All schemes below are separated of finite type over $k$, and all morphisms are $k$-morphisms. Put $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$ for $n\ge1$. For a scheme $T$ use the ordinary derived category $D(\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E))$ of strict varying-coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Write $\mathcal C_T$ for its full subcategory whose levels have bounded intrinsically constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude, in common intervals independent of $n$ [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers, def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. No normalization is required. At level $n$ write $\mathcal C_{T,n}=D^b_{ctf}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A_n)$ in the ordinary constant-ring module derived category. For each separated finite-type map $h$ choose a coefficient-independent compactification and write $F_h=Rh_{!,\bullet}$ and $F_{h,n}=Rh_{!,A_n}$ [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels].

Let $h:Z\to Y$ be separated of finite type, let $Z=U\cup V$, and put $W=U\cap V$. For each open $D\subseteq Z$ write $F_D=F_{h|_D}$ and suppose the compact-support functors used preserve the subcategories $\mathcal C_D$. Use their exact composition and open adjunctions [lem-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-calculus]. Fix $K\in\mathcal C_Y$. Suppose $(P,\epsilon_U)$ and $(Q,\epsilon_V)$ are representing pairs on $U,V$: for $D=U,V$, the map
$$a\longmapsto\epsilon_DF_D(a):\operatorname{Hom}(N,G_D)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}(F_DN,K)$$
is bijective for every $N\in\mathcal C_D$, where $G_U=P$ and $G_V=Q$.

For every further open inclusion $i:D\hookrightarrow U$, the restriction $P|_D$ represents the analogous functor with counit $\epsilon_U F_U(i_!i^*P\to P)$; the same holds on $V$. There is a unique counit-preserving isomorphism $c:P|_W\xrightarrow{\sim}Q|_W$. Let $G\in\mathcal C_Z$ and $a_U:G|_U\simeq P$, $a_V:G|_V\simeq Q$ be any binary fibre gluing with $a_V|_W=c\,a_U|_W$, as in [lem-sp-tower-binary-ctf-fibre]. Then there exists $\epsilon:F_ZG\to K$ such that
$$\epsilon F_Z(j_{D!}G|_D\to G)=\epsilon_D F_D(a_D)\quad(D=U,V),$$
and every such lift is a representing counit:
$$\theta_M:a\longmapsto\epsilon F_Z(a):\operatorname{Hom}(M,G)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}(F_ZM,K)\quad(M\in\mathcal C_Z),$$
naturally in $M$.

The lift satisfies the factorization of $(\epsilon_UF_U(a_U),\epsilon_VF_V(a_V))$ across the compact-support image of the signed open-cover triangle, whose overlap composite is zero. On the triangle $A\to B\to M\to A[1]$, with $A=j_{W!}(M|_W)$ and $B=j_{U!}(M|_U)\oplus j_{V!}(M|_V)$, the maps $\theta$ form a morphism of the exact five-term Hom segments with terms $B[1],A[1],M,B,A$. The four outer maps are the local representing bijections under open adjunction, and the central map is bijective. The conclusion asserts existence and representability of the lift, not uniqueness of arbitrary glued derived morphisms.

Functor.map_comp and associativity prove all four squares, including the signed shifted and connecting squares. Apply Mathlib AddMonoidHom.bijective_of_surjective_of_bijective_of_bijective_of_injective, using outer B[1] surjective, A[1] and B bijective, A injective.
